blurb: Rick Griffin's "Flying Eyeball" poster (BG-105) for the Jimi Hendrix Experience, John Mayall & the Bluesbreakers, and Albert King at San Francisco's Fillmore Auditorium, February 1-4, 1968 - Griffin's first Bill Graham commission and one of the defining images of the San Francisco psychedelic poster scene alongside contemporaries Wes Wilson and Victor Moscoso.
